slide_position_method.instrument: Bb trombone open side; F-attachment fallback for notes with no open-side position
slide_position_method.reference: position 1 practical Bb2 = MIDI46; partials 2-10 rounded to equal temperament, matching TB2 reading
slide_position_method.low_note: F-attachment positions are marked 1F-6F where required; confirm against actual instrument and tuning.
slide_position_method.order: shortest conventional open slide first; alternate positions follow; amber cue candidates remain for reference.
